title: Saudi Arabia Announces Operation Against Houthi Support Sources; Houthi Media Reports Strikes on Port Pier and Vessel
detail: Saudi Arabia announced an operation to neutralize sources of Houthi support, while Houthi media said Saudi strikes hit a pier and a vessel in a Yemeni port. Only headlines and summaries were available; the port, damage and casualties are not confirmed, and the Houthi claim is unverified.
